overview: Make chunks searchable via hybrid lexical + semantic retrieval (tsvector + pgvector IVFFlat) and expose a deterministic IDs-only hybridSearch() contract for downstream features like chat.
goals: Upgrade chunking from per-page chunks to small deterministic chunks suitable for citations.
Enable lexical retrieval via tsvector + GIN for chunks.
Enable semantic retrieval via pgvector embeddings + IVFFlat with conservative, data-aware index creation.
Provide a single hybridSearch() function that returns ranked chunk IDs + metadata (IDs-only contract).
Provide a dev-only debug spike endpoint to make retrieval tuning and failures visible.
nonGoals: OCR/layout geometry and precise highlight polygons.
A full retrieval eval harness beyond minimal tests/debug endpoint.
successMetrics: For a seeded pack folder, a representative query retrieves relevant chunk(s) in the top K results (manual proof acceptable for v0).
Chunks are materially smaller than whole pages and carry deterministic metadata for citations.
Debug endpoint outputs tuning context (lists/probes/hit counts) so retrieval can be tuned without guesswork.
openQuestions: Do we add a golden-questions Recall@K fixture now, or defer to a later retrieval quality slice?
Where should hybridSearch() live long-term: apps/web (web-only) or packages/core (shared) with adapters?

stack.hosting: Local dev (docker-compose) today; target deployments vary but must support Postgres + pgvector.
stack.auth: PoC: no end-user auth; dev-only spike endpoints are gated (SPIKES_ENABLED) and some admin-only endpoints require X-Orbital-Admin-Token.

routes.name: Hybrid Search Debug (Spike)
routes.purpose: Dev-only endpoint to run hybridSearch() for a folder/index_version/query and inspect hits + tuning knobs.

chunking.determinism: Deterministic for (document_id, index_version); re-ingest produces identical chunk boundaries and hashes.

ivfflatIndexingStrategy.notes: Avoid creating IVFFlat with unrealistic lists on tiny datasets; log lists/probes/nVectors for tuning.

rules: Chunking must be deterministic for a given (document_id, index_version) input.
hybridSearch() must return an IDs-only contract (chunk IDs + metadata), not hydrated chunk text.
Vector indexing must avoid IVFFlat tiny-dataset footguns by creating the index conservatively and logging tuning context (lists/probes/nVectors).
Debug-only routes must live under /spikes/* and be gated; do not add new dev-only endpoints at target paths.

stories.title: Deterministic small chunking on ingest
stories.description: As a developer, I want ingest to produce small deterministic chunks per page so that citations and retrieval operate on meaningful units.
acceptanceCriteria: Example: Given a two-page PDF with ~3000 chars per page, ingest persists more than 2 chunks total for index_version=v1; each chunk has metadata_json.chunker_id='char_window_v0' with page_number and char_start/char_end.

Example: Re-ingesting the same document_id for the same index_version produces identical chunk boundaries and identical text_hash values (idempotent by unique (document_id, index_version, chunk_index)).
Negative: If a PDF exceeds ingest caps (e.g., > MAX_PAGES), ingest fails closed with a safe error and does not write partial chunk rows for that document/index_version.

stories.title: Lexical + vector fields exist on chunks and are indexed safely
stories.description: As a developer, I want chunks to support both lexical and semantic retrieval so that exact-term and conceptual queries can find evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Example: Schema includes chunks.text_tsv (tsvector) with a GIN index, and lexical queries use websearch_to_tsquery('english', query) and ts_rank_cd for scoring.

Example: Schema includes embedding vector(1536), embedding_model, embedded_at; embeddings are written for chunks during ingest, and IVFFlat index creation is deferred until nVectors >= 500 with lists computed as clamp(1,100,floor(nVectors/1000)).
Negative: If pgvector extension is missing/unavailable, semantic retrieval fails closed with a safe error (and does not silently pretend semantic search is working).

stories.title: hybridSearch() returns ranked chunk hits and a debug endpoint makes tuning visible
stories.description: As a feature builder (chat, quick start), I want a single hybridSearch() function that returns ranked chunk IDs so that downstream features can rely on one retrieval contract.
acceptanceCriteria: Example: hybridSearch({folderId,indexVersion,queryText}) returns a deterministic ordered list of hits including chunk_id/document_id/page_start/page_end plus score and optional lex_score/sem_score; default tuning is kLex=20, kSem=20, kFinal=10, lexWeight=0.55, semWeight=0.45.

Example: A dev-only spike endpoint /spikes/retrieval/hybrid-search returns the top K hits for a query and includes tuning context (nVectors, lists, probes, kLex/kSem/kFinal, hitCountsLex/hitCountsSem).
Negative: If queryText is empty/invalid, the endpoint returns 400 with the standard safe error envelope and no internal stack trace or provider payload.
